# GitHub

> > GitHub is the world's leading AI-powered developer platform for building, scaling, and securing software with tools like GitHub Copilot, Actions, Codespaces, and Advanced Security.

GitHub provides comprehensive collaboration, CI/CD, and code security solutions for developers and enterprises. The platform integrates AI assistance through Copilot, cloud development environments via Codespaces, automated workflows with Actions, and extensive security features including Dependabot and Advanced Security.

## Key Topics

- GitHub Copilot
- GitHub Actions
- GitHub Codespaces
- GitHub Advanced Security
- CI/CD
- Code Security
- AI Code Assistant
- Developer Platform
- Open Source
- Code Review
- Dependabot
- GitHub Packages
- GitHub CLI
- Collaboration
- Developer Community

- [GitHub Homepage](https://github.com/): AI-powered developer platform homepage featuring Copilot, Actions & more
- [GitHub Features](https://github.com/features): Overview of GitHub features: Codespaces, Copilot, Actions & security
- [GitHub Organization](https://github.com/github): GitHub's official organization profile with 535 repos and products

## Documentation

- [GitHub Docs](https://docs.github.com/): Complete documentation for GitHub products, developers & administrators

## Tools & Marketplace

- [GitHub Marketplace](https://github.com/marketplace): Developer tools marketplace with AI models, CI/CD, and automation tools
